The existing closePosition quantity validation remains an effect-specific before-image/precondition at the transaction/provider leaf; it is not replaced by a generic guard or applied to unrelated leaves.

entries.currentBehavior: For placeOrder, currentValue is the first matching raw symbol's marketValue. Positive cashQty is used directly; otherwise positive quantity is multiplied by an existing position's marketPrice. New-symbol quantity with no existing position leaves addedValue zero and passes. A non-positive netLiquidation forces percent to zero, so a large order can pass. Side, multiplier, currencies, FX, pending intents, and order terms are ignored.
entries.problem: The rule can fail open exactly when valuation is unavailable, treats zero/negative equity as zero risk, and conflates display symbols. It adds sells/shorts as positive exposure and can misvalue contracts with multipliers or different currencies. A read-only broker snapshot does not include durable plans accepted concurrently, so the limit can be exceeded by two individually passing orders.
preservedBehavior: Default 25% and Decimal precision are retained; existing marked exposure plus a new positive exposure is still compared under canonical PercentPoints.

The old non-placeOrder bypass remains source evidence only; target applicability is declared per effect leaf and may be NotApplicable only for a descriptor-proven non-increasing effect, while missing exposure or required-term evidence fails closed.
